story.fullStory:
Robin S's "Show Me Love" reached #5 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Show Me Love" is a song by the American singer Robin S.

It was written by Allen George and Fred McFarlane and released in October 1990 by Champion Records in the United Kingdom.

In 1992, a remix by the Swedish house music producer StoneBridge was released in Europe, the US and Japan.

The song peaked at #5 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 28 weeks on the chart.
